B's indigo border, badge and filled button are clean and cohesive, but its larger heading competes a little more with the recommended card. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers mark Studio with several cues: a 'Most popular' badge, a lift with a shadow and a button that stands out. A's feature lists are a bit cleaner because they have no extra tagline text, but B's short descriptions don't compete with the prices.
